name: audiodn
description: Hosted audio library for Cursor agents — store, play, and preview files you generate or find, with secure upload/playback APIs for your app.

ADN_API_KEY.title: AudioDN API Access key
ADN_API_KEY.description: Optional. Mint a server-side API Access key at https://account.audiodeliverynetwork.com (Settings → API Keys). Knowledge tools work without it. Set this to list collections, store audio from the agent, mint play sessions, and preview tracks. Never put this key in client or component code.
